stateless.heading: Stateless functions
stateless.note: Pure calculations: they never touch the database or the session. Everything they need arrives in the request, so the same input always returns the same output and leaves no trace on the server.

activity.heading: Server activity
activity.subtitle: shared memory
activity.note: Counters kept in the process RAM. Everyone who opens the application sees the same values, and they are lost when the server restarts.
wishlist.heading: My wishlist
wishlist.subtitle: session, yours only
wishlist.note: It lives in your session (a signed cookie). It survives between requests, but another browser would see a different list. Click ☆ in the catalogue.
